description: Returns reference data for the night-out planner: some places with validated venues (not a ranking and not a coverage claim), supported vibes, route styles, notes on addresses and place names, and the relay rules this server publishes (validated venues only, no invented details, legal drinking age where they are). Not required before a plan. Read-only and free.
name: drinkedin_get_guide

outputSchema.description: The guide reply. status and meta are always present.

largest_places.description: Some places with validated venues; not a ranking and not a coverage claim.

meaning.description: What the result means, for the assistant.

meta.description: Versions of the tool and of the drinkedin-night-out skill these replies suit, and the server's docs page.

next.description: Ready follow-up calls: tool, why and args.

notices.description: Notice codes, such as legal_drinking_age and hours_unverified.

retry_after_seconds.description: On an error reply when the planner is busy: seconds to wait.

rules.description: The rules this server publishes for relaying a plan.

say_to_owner.description: A plain sentence for the person.

status.description: ok, or error on a fault.

styles.description: Route styles: id, label, summary, default stops and walking limit.

title: Night-out guide
